name: Setting Goals
overview: Setting goals according to Scripture involves trusting the LORD wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. God encourages us to delight in Him, promising to grant the desires of a heart aligned with His will (Psalms 37:4). Effective planning and diligence are emphasized, with Proverbs highlighting the importance of preparing our work carefully and acting with patience to achieve abundance (Proverbs 21:5; 24:27). Furthermore, Habakkuk 2:2 calls for clarity in our vision, making our goals plain so that they can be pursued with purpose, while Matthew 19:26 reminds us that what may seem impossible with human effort is possible through God’s power.
